cases.name: play-after-seek-to-end
cases.html:
<!DOCTYPE html><script>
const EVN = ['loadstart','progress','suspend','abort','error','emptied','stalled','loadedmetadata','loadeddata','canplay','canplaythrough','playing','waiting','seeking','seeked','ended','durationchange','timeupdate','play','pause','ratechange','resize','volumechange'];
const EVO = [];
const r2 = x => Math.round(x * 100) / 100;
const q4 = x => Math.round(x * 4) / 4;
const cq = m => (m.paused || m.seeking) && !m.error ? r2(m.currentTime) : q4(m.currentTime);
const rngq = t => Array.from({length: t.length}, (_, i) => q4(t.start(i)) + '-' + q4(t.end(i))).join(',');
const QUIET = new Set(['progress', 'suspend', 'durationchange', 'resize', 'loadedmetadata']);
function watch(m, tag = '', names = EVN) {
  names.forEach(n => m.addEventListener(n, e => {
    const last = EVO[EVO.length - 1];
    if ((n === 'timeupdate' || n === 'progress' || n === 'suspend') && last && last.n === n && last.tag === tag) { last.k++; return; }
    EVO.push({n, tag, k: 1, t: e.timeStamp, rs: m.readyState, ns: m.networkState, ct: cq(m), p: m.paused});
  }));
}
const evs = () => EVO.map(o => o.n + (o.tag ? '@' + o.tag : '') + (o.k > 1 ? '*' : '') + (QUIET.has(o.n) ? '' : ' rs=' + o.rs + ' ns=' + o.ns) + ' ct=' + o.ct + (o.p ? ' P' : ''));
const S = m => ({rs: m.readyState, ns: m.networkState, paused: m.paused, ended: m.ended, seeking: m.seeking, ct: cq(m), dur: m.duration, played: rngq(m.played), err: m.error ? m.error.code : null});
const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));
const once = (m, n, ms = 4000) => new Promise(r => { const to = setTimeout(() => r('timeout'), ms); m.addEventListener(n, () => { clearTimeout(to); r(n); }, {once: true}); });
const mark = (m, s) => EVO.push({n: '--- ' + s, tag: '', k: 1, t: performance.now(), rs: m.readyState, ns: m.networkState, ct: cq(m), p: m.paused});
</script><video id=v src=a.mp4 preload=auto muted></video><script>watch(v)</script>
